gatekeeper_port.description: Port number on which the gatekeeper listens for incoming gridFTP and data transfer requests. Must be accessible through firewall.

gatekeeper_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the gatekeeper's X.509 host certificate file.

gatekeeper_key_path.description: Absolute path to the gatekeeper's X.509 host private key file (must be readable only by root).

trusted_ca_dir.description: Path to the directory containing trusted CA certificates (X.509 certificates) for validating client certificates.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker threads to handle incoming requests. Adjust based on expected load and system resources.

bind_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the gatekeeper to. Empty string binds to all interfaces (0.0.0.0). For security, consider binding to a specific interface.

debug.description: Enable or disable verbose debug logging. Set to 'true' only for troubleshooting; impacts performance and log volume.

enable_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for gatekeeper connections. Should be left enabled unless in trusted, isolated environments.

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed source hostnames or IP addresses (exact match). If empty, no host restriction applies.

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed source networks in CIDR notation (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). If empty, no network restriction applies.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the gatekeeper log file.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the log file before rotation. Set to 0 to disable automatic rotation.

log_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep. Only applies if log rotation is enabled (i.e., log_max_size > 0).

tcp_keepalive.description: Enable or disable TCP keepalive probes on accepted connections to detect dead peers.

tcp_keepidle.description: Seconds of idle time before TCP starts sending keepalive probes.

tcp_keepcnt.description: Number of unacknowledged keepalive probes before the connection is considered dead.
